text: Did Mama and Papa confirm the train time?
Not yet. I texted mama at lunch and she said she'd ask papa
Ok. The one they sent me was the 10:02 from tokyo, arrives shin-osaka before noon
I think that's the one. They wanted something that gets here before lunch
[photo: cardboard box with masking tape on it, shelf in the hall]
Oh the ornaments are in there?
The bell thing and the paper crane string. The rest is just old tinsel
We need the bell thing. Mama will ask where it is
One of my kids cried today because glue got on his shirt. Then he cried again because he couldn't find the glue
Not yet. Waiting on the rice
I'll get the box down tomorrow
Which one has the red tape
The one next to the bike
Did papa say anything about the train or just mama
Don't know. I'll ask in the morning
